text_markup: Any effects making use of modified values maintain their restrictions and specifications with the new values.
text_plain: Any effects making use of modified values maintain their restrictions and specifications with the new values.

examples.text_markup: While the result of a successful trace from {card:Flare} is imminent, the Corp triggers {card:The Cleaners} to increase the imminent meat damage by 1. Even though the damage from {card:Flare} has been increased from 2 to 3, none of that meat damage can be prevented.
examples.text_plain: While the result of a successful trace from Flare is imminent, the Corp triggers The Cleaners to increase the imminent meat damage by 1. Even though the damage from Flare has been increased from 2 to 3, none of that meat damage can be prevented.
